places.name: La Parmac Hotel & Restaurant
places.evidence: TripAdvisor reviews thank 'Mr. Parmac' by name; multiple reviews describe 'approachable owner who adds a personal touch'; family-name business (Parmac-Com SRL, est. 1994)

places.name: Shaormeria Nelu
